records.summary: About 60% of 2025 investment went to machines (servers), with a fairly similar split expected in 2026.
records.speaker: Anat Ashkenazi, SVP and CFO, Alphabet and Google

evidence.quote: Approximately 60% of our investment in 2025, and it's going to be fairly similar in 2026, went towards machines; so, the servers.

qualifiers.quote: Approximately 60% of our investment in 2025, and it's going to be fairly similar in 2026, went towards machines; so, the servers.

records.summary: 40% of investment is long duration assets, namely data centers and networking equipment.
records.speaker: Anat Ashkenazi, SVP and CFO, Alphabet and Google

evidence.quote: And then 40% is what you would refer to as long duration assets, which is our data centers and networking equipment.

records.summary: Buildings in the long-duration asset class may depreciate over 40 years or longer; other components may be shorter.
records.speaker: Anat Ashkenazi, SVP and CFO, Alphabet and Google

evidence.quote: the building could be 40 years or longer

qualifiers.quote: Other components may be less than that.

records.summary: For 2026, just over half of ML compute is expected to go toward the Cloud business.
records.speaker: Anat Ashkenazi, SVP and CFO, Alphabet and Google

evidence.quote: And for 2026, just over half of our ML compute is expected to go towards the Cloud business.

gaps: No explicit dollar amount for total CapEx or for the machine versus long-duration asset components was provided in the packet.
The 2026 machine/long-duration split is described only as 'fairly similar' to 2025, without a stated percentage.
The exact useful life of non-building long-duration components is not specified beyond 'may be less than' 40 years.
